description: Defines the abstract class 'Stackwalker' for stack unwinding in crash analysis, including methods for walking the call stack, handling system info, and symbolization. It also declares related classes and utility functions.

classes.name: Stackwalker
classes.description: Abstract base class for stack unwinding, providing methods to walk call stacks, handle system info, and symbolize frames.

methods.name: Walk
methods.description: Performs stack walking to populate a CallStack, identifying modules without symbols and with corrupt symbols.

methods.name: StackwalkerForCPU
methods.description: Factory method to create a concrete Stackwalker subclass suitable for the CPU type.

methods.name: set_max_frames
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of frames to walk.

methods.name: max_frames
methods.description: Retrieves the current maximum frame limit.

methods.name: set_max_frames_scanned
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of frames to scan during stack unwinding.
